ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Tune-Up: Fixes & Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
A collection of small fixes and optional tweaks for vanilla RimWorld. Every part can be turned on or off in the mod settings (restart required). Fixes and the tweaks marked (on by default) start enabled; the other tweaks are off.
Fixes: - Faction leaders: fixes the "Faction leader for X is null" error. - History graph: removes the History tab lag in long-running colonies. - Right-click menu: stops the stutter when a right-click menu opens and while it is open on the map. - Trade setup: removes the freeze when a trade window opens with many items (and with Auto Seller). - Mechs in sieges: fixes the error spam when a siege includes mechs added by other mods. - Food policy during mental breaks: wardens no longer bring restricted food to a prisoner having a mental break. - Tend bleeding prisoners first: wardens skip feeding while a prisoner is bleeding or has surgery scheduled. - Prisoner food delivery keeps up: when prisoners get hungry, one trip brings food for everyone in the cell who needs it. - Banished slaves free their bed (Ideology): a banished slave no longer keeps their slave bed after leaving. - Ejected genepacks stay out: genepacks you eject from a gene bank get auto-load turned off, so haulers do not put them back (Biotech). - Hungry pets find food across the map: an urgently hungry colony animal that finds no food within its short search range searches the whole map, instead of starving far from the food stock in a large base. - Farskip home unloads prisoners (Royalty): prisoners carrying caravan goods get unloaded after a farskip home, like after a normal caravan arrival. - Aligned corner icons: the search and codex buttons in the bottom-right corner no longer push the icons after them off the grid (always on, no setting). - Official translation fixes: fixes quest text shown as ERR and generated text left in English that a translation file cannot override, and a duplicate message after social fights (currently Traditional Chinese).
Tweaks: - Xenogerm queue: a bill-style queue for the gene assembler (Biotech). - Mute labor and birth sounds (Biotech). - Remove fog of war: reveals the map on generation or load, except fogged areas where revealing would trigger something. - Faction icons in caravan lists (on by default): shows the faction icon of guests, prisoners and other non-colony pawns. - Caravan encounters stay on the current map (on by default): caravan event dialogs open without switching to the world map. - Pin resources (on by default): left-click a resource in the categorized resource list to keep it shown while its category is collapsed, even at 0. - Nutrient paste stock (on by default): a "dispense until you have X" target for nutrient paste dispensers, shared by the whole map. - Mod update notes (on by default, Steam version): the main menu's top-left box lists your active Workshop mods by update time, newly updated ones highlighted, with their change notes. - Break up social fights: anyone who sees a social fight nearby may step in to stop it; a bad mood makes insults and fights more likely. - Short names on the map (on by default): long names under pawns are cut short; hover or select the pawn to see the full name. - Ghouls can wear apparel: ghouls keep their clothes when turned and can be ordered to wear clothes and armor, still no weapons (Anomaly). - Caravan: abandon all dead at once (on by default): one button on the caravan Items tab abandons every human corpse and tainted apparel; animal corpses are kept. - Taskbar letter badge (on by default): the letters waiting on screen are shown as a small badge over the game's taskbar button, counted and coloured like the most urgent one; critical alerts turn the badge red, or show a red dot when there are no letters; with no letters, top-left messages show a coloured dot while on screen; a pause sign shows while the game is paused (Windows only). - Right-click to dismiss bundled letters (on by default): right-clicking the "N more..." letter dismisses all the letters folded into it; letters still waiting for a choice stay. - Visitors take shelter: in cold, heat, rain or while enemies are around, trader caravans and visitors wait in a barn, dining room or storeroom instead of leaving early; at night they sleep in a barn or storeroom. - Confirm before closing the game window (on by default): closing the window during a game asks first, like Quit to OS in the menu; commitment mode saves, then quits. - Slaves use prisoner beds (Ideology): slaves can sleep and recover in prisoner beds, so they can share the prison wing. - Prisoners help out by personality: kind prisoners tend and feed bedridden cellmates; hard-working or neurotic prisoners clean their cell. - Calmer prison breaks and slave rebellions: escaping prisoners have no keys; prisoners use recreation buildings in their room and slaves take recreation like colonists, which calms prisoners and raises slaves' suppression (slaves slack off on it now and then, more often the lower their suppression, which only pauses the fall); each one decides on their own whether to join a break or rebellion. - Hide slaves from the colonist bar: slaves get no portrait on the colonist bar, on maps or in caravans; slave alerts still show (Ideology). - Practice on trees for recreation: pawns with a Shooting or Melee passion shoot at trees outside the home area with a gun or hit them with a melee weapon for dexterity recreation, without damaging them; stray shots never hit anyone. Brawlers only use melee weapons; psychopaths and bloodlust pawns also use enemy and animal corpses. - Background music button (on by default): a music note in the bottom-right toggle icons turns the background music off and on without changing the music volume setting; scroll the mouse wheel over it to change the music volume; a key can be bound to it. - Cycle keys for prisoners, visitors, animals and mechs: with an enemy, prisoner, visitor, colony animal, colony mech or wild animal selected, the next/previous colonist keys (, and .) cycle through the others of the same kind on the current map; downed enemies count, fogged pawns are skipped; slaves get their own cycle while hidden from the colonist bar; a quiet tick plays when any cycle, colonists included, comes back to the pawn it started from. - Camera follows the pawn it jumped to (on by default): after a jump that selects a pawn (cycle keys, portrait double-click, alerts, letters, messages, quests), the camera keeps following it until you move the camera, change the selection or the pawn leaves the map. - Psychic rituals sorted by psychic sensitivity (Anomaly, on by default): portraits in the psychic ritual dialog show each pawn's psychic sensitivity, and the candidates are listed highest first. - Smelt and destroy bill improvements (on by default): items without quality count as legendary for the bill's quality filter, so a range such as awful to normal no longer smelts them; a "Keep X of each" repeat mode replaces the unusable "Do until you have X" on smelt, destroy and burn bills: for every item type the bill allows, the X with the highest market value on the map are left alone and only the rest are processed, still subject to the bill's quality and hit point filters. Items worn or carried by pawns are not counted. - Camera jumps avoid the open inspect tab (on by default): with a tab such as gear or health open, jumping to a colonist centres them in the uncovered screen area to the right of the tab; optionally also when a tab opens over the selected pawn. - Field tending and cheaper medicine: a bleeding patient outside a bed is tended where they are until the bleeding stops, then carried to a free bed; with no bed free, a downed patient is tended where they lie for everything and an undrafted one on their feet or asleep on the ground for bleeding or a deadly disease; downed fast bleeders get only carried medicine or none; without a wound that can get infected or a deadly disease the cheapest allowed medicine is used; optionally tends fast bleeders before capturing them. - Quicksave, save and quit, Continue: F5 saves right away to Quicksave-1, -2 and so on, overwriting the oldest once the set number (5 by default) is reached; the quit confirmation gets a "Save and quit" button; a main menu Continue button (or Enter) loads your newest save. - Screensaver: after some idle minutes (5 by default) while the game runs unpaused, the interface hides like F11 and the camera follows a random awake colonist, switching every 30 seconds by default; scroll zooms and the next/previous colonist keys switch colonists; any other key press, click or a pause ends it (moving the mouse does not) and restores the camera and selection. - Refugees change their clothes (Royalty): hospitality refugees follow an apparel policy (optionally one you pick for them) and replace worn-out clothes on their own; other quest lodgers keep their outfit. - Default policies for new prisoners and slaves: the food policy you pick for each, and an apparel policy for slaves. - Visitors leave colony food alone: traders, visitors and allies eat their own food; once it runs out and they get hungry enough, they may eat colony food your chosen policy allows. - Guards for dangerous hunts: hunting an animal that can fight back calls nearby armed colonists along as guards, more of them for tougher animals and packs. - Hybrid children keep a matching xenotype: a Hybrid child whose genes closely match one heritable xenotype gets that xenotype (Biotech). - Tell faction colors apart: factions with nearly identical colors are nudged apart on load. - Drag to reorder: right-drag to reorder the bottom bar, architect categories, buildings and command buttons. - Compact colonist bar: the colonist bar shrinks while the mouse is away and expands on hover.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. Load after Harmony.
This mod was developed with the help of AI coding tools (Claude Code). Full source code is included in the Source folder for review.
